name: Misato (Kumamoto, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Misato town emblem in green and orange: a green stylised letter M-shaped device enclosing an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Misato, a town in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 November 2004.

features.role: Misato town emblem — a green stylised letter M-shaped device enclosing an orange disc
